name: What are the maintenance requirements for aging-in-place friendly flooring?

mainEntity.name: What are the maintenance requirements for aging-in-place friendly flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for aging-in-place friendly flooring focuses on keeping surfaces clean and safe. Low-pile carpets require regular vacuuming to prevent dust and allergen buildup, and occasional deep cleaning. Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) and non-slip tiles are low maintenance, typically requiring sweeping or vacuuming, and damp mopping with a mild cleaner. Avoid harsh chemicals that can damage finishes or leave slippery residues. Promptly clean spills to prevent stains and ensure surfaces remain slip-resistant. Regular inspection for wear and tear, especially in high-traffic areas, helps maintain safety over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Aging-in-place flooring needs simple maintenance: regular vacuuming for carpet, and sweeping/damp mopping for LVP and tile. Prompt spill cleanup is essential.
